{{Quote|And watch out for their leader&mdash;he's got a reputation for hunting Trandoshans, rancors&hellip; not to mention Jedi.|Ledo Melnic|<ref name="Down" />}}
'''War-Master''' '''Rhigoth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who was the leader of a group of Mandalorians that started shaking down merchants in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When [[Ledo Melnic]], a local magistrate, ordered security to run them out of town, the Mandalorians crippled three of his officers and took over an old storage facility, converting it into a bunker. Rhigoth had a reputation for hunting [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]], and even members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], but the outside help hired by Melnic successfully stormed the bunker and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him along with the others.<ref name="Down" />
